author: Backblaze
description: Official Backblaze B2 MCP server for buckets, files, keys, Object Lock, and S3 storage.
name: Backblaze B2 MCP Server

tools.name: b2_authorize_account
tools.description: Authorize with B2 and return account info including accountId, apiUrl, and downloadUrl. The server handles authorization automatically, but this tool is useful for verifying credentials and retrieving account details.

tools.name: b2_create_bucket
tools.description: Create a persistent B2 bucket with optional metadata, CORS, lifecycle, default encryption, and Object Lock enablement. Use for initial provisioning with a key that has writeBuckets; use b2_update_bucket for later settings changes and s3_head_bucket to check S3 reachability. Bucket names are globally unique, case-insensitive, 6-63 characters, letters/digits/hyphens/periods, and cannot start with 'b2-', begin/end with a period, contain '..', or look like an IPv4 address.

bucketName.description: Globally unique bucket name: 6-63 characters, letters/digits/hyphens/periods, case-insensitive, no b2- prefix, no leading/trailing period, no '..', and not an IPv4 address.

bucketType.description: Visibility for file downloads: allPrivate requires authorization; allPublic makes objects world-readable by URL.

bucketInfo.description: Custom metadata: <=10 pairs. Keys: 1-50 UTF-8 bytes, chars A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ` ~ ! # $ % ^ & * ' | + -, no b2- prefix. Values total <=10,000 UTF-8 bytes. Omit to create the bucket without custom metadata.

corsRuleName.description: Unique name: 6-63 letters, digits, hyphens; no b2- prefix.

corsRules.description: CORS rules: <=100. allowedOrigins/allowedOperations require 1-100 non-empty strings; allowedHeaders/exposeHeaders allow <=100. Strings <=999 chars. Per-rule UTF-8 total <1,000. Names unique. Omit to create the bucket without CORS rules.

lifecycleRules.description: Optional B2 lifecycle rules applied after creation. Use for automatic hiding, deletion of hidden versions, or cancellation of unfinished large-file uploads; use s3_put_bucket_lifecycle only when you need the S3 lifecycle API shape.

fileNamePrefix.description: Object-key prefix this rule matches; use an empty string to match the bucket.

daysFromHidingToDeleting.description: Optional days after a file is hidden before B2 permanently deletes it; minimum 1.

daysFromUploadingToHiding.description: Optional days after upload before B2 hides the current file version; minimum 1.

daysFromStartingToCancelingUnfinishedLar.description: Optional days before B2 cancels unfinished large-file uploads; minimum 1.

defaultServerSideEncryption.description: Optional default server-side encryption for new files in this bucket. Omit to create the bucket without a bucket default encryption setting.

mode.description: Use SSE-B2 to make AES256 the bucket default; use none for no bucket default encryption.

algorithm.description: Encryption algorithm. B2 supports AES256 for SSE-B2.

fileLockEnabled.description: Enable Object Lock (file lock) on the bucket at creation. (Object Lock can also be enabled later on an existing bucket via b2_update_bucket.) Must be true before any retention or legal hold can be applied to files in this bucket.

tools.name: b2_create_group_member
tools.description: Create a Backblaze account for a new Partner group member. In file sink mode, the one-time application key secret is written to the configured out-of-band secret sink and the MCP response contains only redacted metadata plus a secretSink pointer. In inline mode, the secret is returned with an explicit warning.

adminAccountId.description: The accountId of the Group admin. Must be authorized for the Partner API.

groupId.description: The Group ID that the new member will join.

memberEmail.description: Email address for the new group member account.

region.description: Optional data region for the new account.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key. Reuse the same value only when retrying the identical group-member creation request.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_create_key
tools.description: Create a B2 application key and route its one-time secret through the configured secret sink. Use for least-privilege scoped credentials; use b2_list_keys to inspect existing keys and b2_delete_key to revoke retired keys. Requires writeKeys, idempotencyKey, and destructive confirmation by policy. File sink mode returns redacted metadata plus a secretSink pointer; inline mode returns the secret only when explicitly enabled. Policy refuses key-management grants and unscoped write/delete grants unless explicit environment overrides are enabled; when B2_MAX_KEY_DURATION_SECONDS is set, it also refuses non-expiring keys or durations above that limit.

keyName.description: Human-readable key name for audits and b2_list_keys output.

capabilities.description: B2 capabilities to grant. They must be allowed by the creating key; listKeys/writeKeys/deleteKeys are refused unless B2_ALLOW_KEY_MGMT_GRANTS=true.

bucketIds.description: Optional bucket ID restrictions. Required by default for keys with write*/delete* capabilities; omit only for intentional account-wide access, and do not combine with bucketId.

bucketId.description: Deprecated single-bucket restriction. Use bucketIds for new integrations; do not provide both.

validDurationInSeconds.description: Optional positive key lifetime in seconds. Omit for no expiration only when B2_MAX_KEY_DURATION_SECONDS is not configured.

namePrefix.description: Optional file-name prefix restriction for file capabilities; omit for no prefix restriction.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key. Reuse the same value only for an identical retry by the same caller; conflicting reuse is rejected.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this durable credential creation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_delete_bucket
tools.description: Delete a B2 bucket. The bucket must be empty — all files and file versions must be deleted first.

bucketId.description: The ID of the bucket to delete.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_delete_key
tools.description: Permanently delete a B2 application key. Use b2_list_keys first to verify applicationKeyId, keyName, capabilities, and dependent systems; use b2_create_key before deletion when rotating credentials. Requires deleteKeys and destructive confirmation by policy. The key secret cannot be recovered, and anything still using the deleted key loses access immediately.

applicationKeyId.description: Exact application key ID to delete; use b2_list_keys to look it up.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_egress_leaders
tools.description: Rank top egress (downloaded bytes) by account or bucket over a period — default month-to-date. For 'who's downloading the most', 'where is egress concentrated'. Returns leaders with each one's share of total egress, from the daily usage reports. Scope follows the caller's key. Needs Usage Reports enabled.

days.description: Rolling window in days (1–90). Omit for current month to date.

tools.name: b2_eject_group_member
tools.description: Eject a member from a Group. The account is NOT deleted — just removed (the member resets their password on next login). Optionally change their email on eject. Cannot be re-added via API (only the Group Management page).

adminAccountId.description: The accountId of the Group admin. Must be authorized for the Partner API.

groupId.description: The Group ID from which to eject the member.

memberAccountId.description: The accountId of the Group member to eject. Must be a member of the specified Group.

email.description: New email for the ejected account. If omitted, the existing email is kept. Must not already be a Backblaze account.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_get_bucket_notification_rules
tools.description: Read the B2 event-notification webhook rules for a bucket. Use before b2_set_bucket_notification_rules to diff or preserve existing rules, because set replaces the complete rule set. Requires readBucketNotifications or writeBucketNotifications, has no side effects, and redacts webhook URL host/path/query, HMAC secrets, and custom-header values in the MCP response.

bucketId.description: Exact bucket ID whose notification rules should be read.

tools.name: b2_largest_files
tools.description: List a bucket's largest objects by size via a live listing. For 'largest files', 'what's taking up space in <bucket>'. Give the bucket by name or bucketId; optional path prefix. Sorting by size requires a full listing, so on very large buckets the scan is bounded by max_scan and a time budget — it then returns the largest among the objects scanned with truncated=true; pass a prefix to focus on a subtree for a complete ranking. Returns name, size, and upload time — never contents.

bucket.description: Bucket name or bucketId to inspect.

limit.description: How many of the largest files to return (default 10, max 100).

max_scan.description: Safety cap on objects scanned (default 50,000, max 500,000). Buckets with millions of files cannot be fully sorted by size in one live call; the scan stops at this cap (or a time budget) and returns truncated=true. Narrow with prefix for an exhaustive ranking of a subtree.

tools.name: b2_list_buckets
tools.description: List B2 buckets for the authorized account. Optionally filter by bucket ID, name, or type. When the key is bucket-scoped and no bucketId/bucketName filter is supplied, requests are automatically narrowed to the authorized bucket IDs. Returns bucket ID, name, type, CORS rules, and lifecycle rules for each bucket. Capped to `limit` buckets (default 100, max 1000) to keep the response small for accounts with many buckets; if more exist the result is truncated with total_bucket_count and a note — raise limit or filter to target specific buckets.

bucketId.description: Filter to a specific bucket by its ID

bucketName.description: Filter to a specific bucket by its name

bucketTypes.description: Filter by bucket types. Defaults to all types.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return (default 100, max 1000). The B2 API returns every bucket in one response; this caps how many are surfaced to keep the payload and token cost bounded. If the account has more buckets than the limit, the result is truncated with total_bucket_count and a note — raise limit (up to 1000) or filter by bucketName / bucketId / bucketTypes.

tools.name: b2_list_group_members
tools.description: List active (ACCEPTED) Group members for a specific Group. Returns up to 1,000 members per call; use nextEmail for pagination. Includes B2 storage stats per member.

adminAccountId.description: The accountId of the Group admin. Must be authorized for the Partner API.

groupId.description: The groupId whose members to list.

startEmail.description: Pagination cursor — the first member email to return. If no exact match, starts from the next email alphabetically.

maxMemberCount.description: Maximum number of members to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

tools.name: b2_list_groups
tools.description: List active Groups administered by a Group admin account. Returns up to 100 groups per call; use nextGroupId for pagination. Requires the account to be authorized for the Partner API.

adminAccountId.description: The accountId of the Group admin. Must be authorized for the Partner API.

groupName.description: Filter by Group name. Returns all Groups with this exact name.

startGroupId.description: Pagination cursor — the groupId to begin listing from.

maxGroupCount.description: Maximum number of Groups to return (1-100). Defaults to 100.

tools.name: b2_list_keys
tools.description: List the application keys associated with the B2 account. Does not return the actual key secrets — only key IDs, names, capabilities, and restrictions.

maxKeyCount.description: Maximum number of keys to return (1-1000).

startApplicationKeyId.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's nextApplicationKeyId.

tools.name: b2_reserve_trial_create_account
tools.description: Reserve a B2 trial account through the Partner API. Available only in explicit inline mode because Reserve Trial has no provider-side recovery path if a file sink write fails after account creation.

email.description: Email address for the new B2 Reserve trial account.

region.description: Optional data region for the new account.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key. Reuse the same value only when retrying the identical reserve-trial account creation request.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_set_bucket_notification_rules
tools.description: Replace the complete B2 event-notification webhook rule set for a bucket. Use b2_get_bucket_notification_rules first and submit the full desired rule set; this is not a patch or append API. Requires writeBucketNotifications and destructive confirmation by policy. Each webhook URL must be a public HTTPS endpoint, and echoed URL details, HMAC secrets, and custom-header values are redacted from the response.

bucketId.description: Exact bucket ID whose notification rules should be replaced.

name.description: Name for this notification rule; must be unique per bucket.

objectNamePrefix.description: Object-key prefix that triggers the rule. Defaults to empty string, which matches every object in the bucket.

eventTypes.description: B2 event types that trigger delivery, for example b2:ObjectCreated:* or b2:ObjectDeleted:*.

url.description: Public https:// webhook URL. localhost, credentials in URLs, private IPs, and non-public DNS targets are rejected before B2 is called.

hmacSha256SigningSecret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Treated as sensitive input and redacted from outputs/logs.

customHeaders.description: Optional custom headers sent with webhook deliveries.

name.description: Custom header name sent with webhook deliveries.

value.description: Custom header value; treated as sensitive and redacted.

isEnabled.description: Whether B2 should deliver events for this rule.

eventNotificationRules.description: Complete replacement rule set for the bucket. Include every rule that should remain; omitted existing rules are removed.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for replacing persistent outbound webhook notification rules when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_unfinished_uploads
tools.description: Find abandoned multipart uploads that silently consume storage in a bucket. For 'bucket bloat', 'stuck/incomplete uploads', 'wasted storage'. Returns count, oldest upload age, and wasted bytes. Give the bucket by name or bucketId. Live listing, bounded by max_uploads and an internal time budget — on a very bloated bucket it returns a truncated result (and wasted_gb may be a lower bound) and recommends a lifecycle rule.

bucket.description: Bucket name or bucketId to inspect.

older_than_days.description: Only count uploads started more than this many days ago (optional).

max_uploads.description: Safety cap on how many unfinished uploads to scan (default 1000, max 10,000). A bucket bloated with abandoned uploads would otherwise trigger an unbounded walk plus a per-upload parts fan-out that times out. If the cap or an internal time budget is hit, the result is truncated and wasted_gb may be a lower bound — add a lifecycle rule to auto-cancel unfinished large files.

tools.name: b2_update_bucket
tools.description: Update persistent settings on an existing B2 bucket: visibility, metadata, CORS, lifecycle, default encryption, replication, Object Lock, and default retention. Requires the writeBuckets capability. Use b2_list_buckets first to inspect the current bucketId/revision and use ifRevisionIs for safer retries; use s3_put_bucket_lifecycle only when you specifically need the S3 lifecycle API shape. Gated cases: bucketType allPublic, fileLockEnabled false, defaultRetention.mode null, lifecycleRules with daysFromHidingToDeleting, and any replicationConfiguration update.

bucketId.description: The exact bucket ID to update, not the bucket name.

bucketType.description: Optional visibility change. allPublic makes objects world-readable by URL and is governed by the configured destructive policy; omit to leave unchanged.

bucketInfo.description: Custom metadata: <=10 pairs. Keys: 1-50 UTF-8 bytes, chars A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ` ~ ! # $ % ^ & * ' | + -, no b2- prefix. Values total <=10,000 UTF-8 bytes. Omit to leave current metadata unchanged.

corsRuleName.description: Unique name: 6-63 letters, digits, hyphens; no b2- prefix.

corsRules.description: CORS rules: <=100. allowedOrigins/allowedOperations require 1-100 non-empty strings; allowedHeaders/exposeHeaders allow <=100. Strings <=999 chars. Per-rule UTF-8 total <1,000. Names unique. On update, provided rules replace the existing set; omit to leave unchanged.

lifecycleRules.description: When provided, replaces the bucket's B2 lifecycle rule set; omit to leave unchanged. Rules that delete hidden versions are destructive in effect and are governed by the configured destructive policy.

fileNamePrefix.description: Object-key prefix this rule matches; use an empty string to match the bucket.

daysFromHidingToDeleting.description: Optional days after a file is hidden before B2 permanently deletes it; minimum 1.

daysFromUploadingToHiding.description: Optional days after upload before B2 hides the current file version; minimum 1.

daysFromStartingToCancelingUnfinishedLar.description: Optional days before B2 cancels unfinished large-file uploads; minimum 1.

defaultServerSideEncryption.description: Default server-side encryption for new files in this bucket. Omit on update to leave unchanged.

mode.description: Use SSE-B2 to make AES256 the bucket default; use none to clear the bucket default.

algorithm.description: Encryption algorithm. B2 supports AES256 for SSE-B2.

replicationConfiguration.description: Optional replication configuration. Omit to leave unchanged; any provided value changes persistent copy behavior and is confirmation-gated.

destinationBucketId.description: Destination bucket ID that receives replicated objects.

fileNamePrefix.description: Optional object-key prefix to replicate; omit for all objects.

includeExistingFiles.description: If true, B2 also queues existing matching files for replication.

isEnabled.description: Whether this replication rule is active.

priority.description: Rule priority used by B2 when rules overlap.

sourceApplicationKeyId.description: Application key ID B2 uses as the replication source credential.

asReplicationSource.description: Source replication settings. Provided rules replace the source config.

sourceToDestinationKeyMapping.description: Mapping from source key IDs to destination key IDs.

asReplicationDestination.description: Destination replication settings for buckets receiving replicated data.

fileLockEnabled.description: Enable Object Lock on the bucket. Unlike S3's PutObjectLockConfiguration (which only enables lock at bucket creation), the B2 native API allows enabling Object Lock on an existing bucket here. Requires the writeBucketRetentions capability.

defaultRetention.description: Default Object Lock retention for newly uploaded objects. Requires Object Lock enabled on the bucket. Send { mode: null, period: null } to clear.

mode.description: Retention mode applied to new objects. null clears the default.

period.description: Retention period, e.g. { duration: 7, unit: 'days' }. null clears the default.

ifRevisionIs.description: Conditional update — only update if the bucket revision matches this value.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for a gated bucket update when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run. Gated cases: bucketType allPublic, fileLockEnabled false, defaultRetention.mode null, lifecycleRules with daysFromHidingToDeleting, or any replicationConfiguration. Non-gated updates do not need it.

tools.name: b2_update_file_legal_hold
tools.description: Set or clear a legal hold on a specific file version in B2. When a legal hold is active, the file cannot be deleted regardless of retention settings. Requires the writeFileLegalHolds capability on the application key.

fileId.description: The B2 file ID of the file to update.

fileName.description: The name of the file (required by the B2 API alongside fileId).

legalHold.description: 'on' to apply a legal hold; 'off' to remove it. B2's write API expects this bare string — not the isClientAuthorizedToRead/value object that b2_get_file_info returns.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this irreversible/protection-removing operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_update_file_retention
tools.description: Set or modify the retention policy on a specific file version in B2. Supports governance and compliance retention modes. In compliance mode, the retain-until date can only be extended. Requires the writeFileRetentions capability.

fileId.description: The B2 file ID of the file to update.

fileName.description: The name of the file (required by the B2 API alongside fileId).

mode.description: Retention mode. null clears the retention policy (governance mode only, with bypassGovernance).

retainUntilTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (ms) until which the file is retained. null when mode is null.

fileRetention.description: Retention policy to apply, or { mode: null, retainUntilTimestamp: null } to clear. This is the flat shape B2's write API expects — do NOT include the read-only isClientAuthorizedToRead/value wrapper that b2_get_file_info returns.

bypassGovernance.description: If true, allows overriding governance-mode retention. Requires bypassGovernance capability.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this irreversible/protection-removing operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: b2_usage_growth
tools.description: Rank accounts by how much STORED data grew or shrank between two points in time, from the daily B2 usage reports (uses stored_gb, the end-of-day snapshot). For 'which customers grew the most/least', 'who's moving data off'. Compares the latest snapshot against one month/quarter/year earlier and fetches only those two days, so it stays fast even on large report buckets. Returns the two dates compared and per-account start vs current GB and % growth (new accounts flagged). Scope follows the caller's key (a partner key sees all its sub-accounts). Needs Usage Reports enabled.

period.description: Compare the latest snapshot against one month, quarter, or year ago. Default month.

days.description: Custom trailing window in days that overrides `period` (e.g. 7 for week-over-week).

tools.name: s3_abort_multipart_upload
tools.description: Abort an in-progress S3-compatible multipart upload and release all associated storage.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: s3_complete_multipart_upload
tools.description: Finalize an S3-compatible multipart upload in B2 by assembling uploaded parts. Use only after s3_create_multipart_upload and s3_presign_upload_part (or s3_upload_part_copy) have produced every required part; use s3_list_parts to verify uploaded parts before retrying. Requires writeFiles. Completion is idempotent only when B2 already committed the exact same part list; if the response is lost, reconcile with s3_head_object or s3_list_object_versions before retrying.

bucket.description: Destination bucket name used to create the multipart upload.

key.description: Destination object key used to create the multipart upload.

partNumber.description: Provider-valid multipart part number from 1-10000 for this ETag; provide each uploaded part once.

etag.description: The ETag from this part's direct PUT response (the s3_presign_upload_part flow).

parts.description: Complete ordered part manifest. Include every part in ascending partNumber order (part numbers are 1-10000); missing or stale ETags fail the completion call.

tools.name: s3_copy_object
tools.description: Copy an object within B2 or between B2 buckets via B2's S3-compatible CopyObject API. The acl input is retained as a no-op S3 compatibility hint; B2 access follows the destination bucket policy.

sourceVersionId.description: Copy a specific version of the source object.

metadataDirective.description: COPY copies metadata from source; REPLACE uses the provided metadata.

contentType.description: New content type (only used with REPLACE).

acl.description: Accepted as a no-op S3 compatibility hint; B2 access follows the destination bucket policy.

tools.name: s3_create_multipart_upload
tools.description: Initiate an S3-compatible multipart upload for a large file in B2. Returns an UploadId to use with s3_presign_upload_part, which mints per-part URLs the client uploads directly to B2.

key.description: The object key for the final assembled file.

serverSideEncryption.description: Server-side encryption. B2 supports SSE-B2 (AES256) only — not SSE-KMS.

tools.name: s3_delete_object
tools.description: Delete one B2 object through the S3-compatible API. Use s3_list_object_versions first when you need to target a specific version or delete marker; use s3_delete_objects for batches up to 1000. Requires deleteFiles and destructive confirmation by policy; targeting a specific versionId additionally requires readFiles, because native B2 version binding is verified first. Omitting versionId applies normal S3 delete semantics and can create a delete marker in versioned buckets; providing versionId permanently removes that version after that binding check.

bucket.description: Bucket name containing the object to delete.

versionId.description: Exact version ID to delete. Omit to delete the current object by S3 semantics, which may create a delete marker for versioned buckets.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: s3_delete_objects
tools.description: Delete multiple objects from a B2 bucket with bounded SDK concurrency (up to 1000 objects).

quiet.description: If true, only return errors (not successes) in the response.

bypassGovernance.description: If true, bypass governance-mode Object Lock retention when deleting specific versions. Requires bypassGovernance capability.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for this destructive/irreversible operation when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: s3_get_bucket_lifecycle
tools.description: Read S3 lifecycle rules for a B2 bucket. Returns B2-supported fields: prefix filter, Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload.

tools.name: s3_get_bucket_location
tools.description: Get the region (location constraint) of a B2 bucket via the S3-compatible API. No native b2_* equivalent — used to verify region/endpoint pairing.

tools.name: s3_get_object
tools.description: Read a SMALL object inline (≤1 MiB, returned base64) — for manifests, sidecars, and configs the agent must inspect — or stream any size to a local path with saveToPath. For real object data, generate a GetObject URL with s3_get_presigned_url and download directly from B2 (bytes never pass through the server or the model context).

versionId.description: Specific version of the object to retrieve.

saveToPath.description: If provided, save the file to this local path.

tools.name: s3_get_presigned_url
tools.description: Generate a short-lived presigned URL bearer capability for one B2 object — GetObject (download) or PutObject (upload). Prefer this for single-object transfers; use s3_create_multipart_upload and s3_presign_upload_part for multipart uploads. The response includes the URL, operation, expiresIn, and expiresAt; treat the URL as sensitive until it expires. This is the preferred path for moving real object data: bytes flow directly between the client/worker and B2 and never pass through the MCP server. Note: presigned POST (browser form uploads) is NOT supported by B2; use a PutObject URL instead.

operation.description: The operation the URL allows: GetObject to download or PutObject to upload.

expiresIn.description: URL expiry in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour, max: 604800 = 7 days).

versionId.description: For GetObject: the specific version ID to target.

contentType.description: For PutObject: restrict the upload to this content type.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation for minting a PutObject presigned URL bearer capability when the effective server destructive policy is 'confirm' and MCP elicitation cannot run.

tools.name: s3_head_bucket
tools.description: Check whether a B2 bucket exists and is reachable on the S3-compatible endpoint with the current credentials. Use this to validate S3-surface reachability (the native b2_list_buckets confirms existence but not S3 reachability).

tools.name: s3_head_object
tools.description: Get metadata for a B2 object without downloading it. Returns content type, size, last modified, ETag, and custom metadata.

tools.name: s3_list_multipart_uploads
tools.description: List in-progress S3-compatible multipart uploads for a B2 bucket. Use to resume or audit unfinished uploads before s3_presign_upload_part, s3_complete_multipart_upload, or s3_abort_multipart_upload; use b2_unfinished_uploads when you need storage-cost analysis across bounded listings. Requires listFiles. Results are paginated with maxUploads (default 100, range 1-1000) and key/upload markers; delimiter responses include commonPrefixes.

bucket.description: Bucket name whose in-progress multipart uploads to list.

prefix.description: Only return multipart uploads whose object keys start with this prefix.

delimiter.description: Optional delimiter, usually '/', to group common key prefixes.

keyMarker.description: Pagination cursor: nextKeyMarker from a previous response.

uploadIdMarker.description: Pagination cursor paired with keyMarker: nextUploadIdMarker from a previous response.

tools.name: s3_list_object_versions
tools.description: List object versions and delete markers in a B2 bucket using the S3-compatible API. Use before version-targeted s3_get_object, s3_head_object, s3_copy_object, or s3_delete_object calls; use s3_list_objects_v2 when current live objects are enough. Requires listFiles. Results are paginated with maxKeys (default 1000, max 1000) and paired key/version markers.

bucket.description: Bucket name whose object versions should be listed.

prefix.description: Only list versions and delete markers for keys that start with this prefix.

delimiter.description: Optional delimiter, usually '/', to group common key prefixes.

maxKeys.description: Maximum versions/delete markers to return (default 1000, range 1-1000).

keyMarker.description: Pagination cursor: nextKeyMarker from a previous response.

versionIdMarker.description: Pagination cursor paired with keyMarker: nextVersionIdMarker from a previous response.

tools.name: s3_list_objects_v2
tools.description: List objects in a B2 bucket via the S3-compatible ListObjectsV2 API. Supports prefix filtering, delimiter-based folder listings, and pagination.

prefix.description: Only return objects whose keys start with this prefix.

delimiter.description: Use '/' to list like a folder tree.

continuationToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response.

startAfter.description: Return objects after this key (exclusive S3 StartAfter semantics).

tools.name: s3_list_parts
tools.description: List the parts that have been uploaded for an in-progress S3-compatible multipart upload.

tools.name: s3_presign_upload_part
tools.description: Generate short-lived presigned PUT URL bearer capabilities for parts of an S3-compatible multipart upload, so the client/worker uploads each part DIRECTLY to B2. Prefer this over s3_get_presigned_url for multipart uploads; use s3_get_presigned_url for single-object PUT/GET transfers. The response includes expiresIn/expiresAt; treat each URL as sensitive until it expires. Flow: s3_create_multipart_upload → s3_presign_upload_part → PUT each part to its URL (capture the ETag from each response header) → s3_complete_multipart_upload with those ETags. Parts except the last must be ≥5 MiB.

partNumbers.description: Part numbers to presign (each 1–10000). Mint all parts at once, or only the missing ones to resume.

expiresIn.description: URL expiry in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour, max: 604800 = 7 days).

tools.name: s3_put_bucket_lifecycle
tools.description: Set S3 lifecycle rules on a B2 bucket; pass rules: [] to clear the S3 lifecycle configuration. Supports AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload, Expiration, and NoncurrentVersionExpiration. B2 does not support Transition/storage-class rules.

id.description: A unique identifier for the rule.

prefix.description: Only apply to objects with this prefix.

days.description: Number of days after creation to expire the object.

noncurrentDays.description: Days after becoming noncurrent to expire the version.

daysAfterInitiation.description: Cancel incomplete multipart uploads after this many days.

rules.description: Rules to set; [] clears the configuration.

confirm.description: Fallback confirmation under 'confirm' when rules is [] or rules expire objects and MCP elicitation cannot run. Not needed for abort-incomplete-upload-only rules.

tools.name: s3_put_object
tools.description: Upload a SMALL object inline (≤1 MiB) to a B2 bucket — for manifests, sidecars, and tiny configs. Provide base64-encoded content or a local file path. For real object data, generate a PutObject URL with s3_get_presigned_url and upload directly to B2 (bytes never pass through the server), or use the multipart tools for large objects.

key.description: The object key (file path within the bucket).

filePath.description: Absolute local path to the file to upload.

acl.description: Accepted as a no-op S3 compatibility hint; B2 bucket policy is unchanged.

serverSideEncryption.description: Server-side encryption. B2 supports SSE-B2 (AES256) only — not SSE-KMS.

storageClass.description: Accepted as a no-op S3 compatibility hint; B2 storage class is unchanged.

tools.name: s3_upload_part_copy
tools.description: Copy a part from an existing B2 object into an in-progress S3-compatible multipart upload. Use this to efficiently assemble large objects from existing parts without re-uploading data.

copySource.description: The source object in 'bucket/key' format, e.g. 'my-bucket/path/to/file.dat'. URL-encode special characters in the key.

copySourceRange.description: Byte range to copy from the source, e.g. 'bytes=0-104857599' for the first 100MB.

copySourceVersionId.description: Version ID of the source object to copy from.
